Baseline.Failure: Valid chunked empty segment was rejected; offline recovery then failed with HTTP send 12029 because the caption segment had not been retained. Baseline stopped after 157 checks.

Fix: After successful HTTP body decoding, accept a zero-byte mapped subtitle response with status 200 and either explicit zero length or chunked framing; preserve rejection for missing terminator, non-subtitle empty media and unknown close-delimited emptiness.
Limitations: Controlled HTTP loopback and native FFmpeg output; no public-site or IDM comparison
Close-delimited zero-byte mapped captions remain unsupported
